commands.command:
mkdir -p /etc/inventory /usr/local/sbin
cat > /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pulls the source-of-truth /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 and keeps
# the local copy on node2 in sync.
set -e
TMP=$(mktemp)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new root@node1 'cat /etc/inventory/app.conf' > "$TMP"
if [ -s "$TMP" ]; then
    mkdir -p /etc/inventory
    if ! cmp -s "$TMP" /etc/inventory/app.conf 2>/dev/null; then
        cp "$TMP" /etc/inventory/app.conf
        chmod 644 /etc/inventory/app.conf
        logger -t sync-inventory-conf "updated /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1"
    fi
fi
rm -f "$TMP"
EOF
chmod 700 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
